newsitem.title: USA: FX, Apache in Poland project pact.
newsitem.headline: FX, Apache in Poland project pact.

text.p: FX Energy Inc said Friday it had signed an agreement for Apache Corp to earn a 50 percent interest in FX's Lublin concession in eastern Poland.
The concession covers about two million acres, FX said. It acquired the oil and gas exploration rights to the area in December.

Terms of the agreement call for Apache to become the operator of the concession, shoot 300 miles of 2-D seismic, and drill at least one well, FX said. Apache must drill a second well prior to the 1998 third quarter in order to earn its 50 percent interest, FX said.
FX said it estimated the cost of Apache's exploration commitment over the next year at about $5 million.
FX said it and Apache also had created an area of mutual interest covering about four million acres on adjacent blocks.
